results.title: Codegen: expression-form `?` eagerly executes skipped `&&` / `||` operands
results.author: dingli06
results.body_snippet: ## Summary On latest main `f99d6d0b37722de206015be9e1c59b04e827c794`, expression-form `?` breaks Boolean short-circuit evaluation. `false && touched()?` and `true || touched()?` both call `touched()`, although that operand must be skipped. A skipped call returning an error also incorrectly terminates the program. This is an observed code-generation correctness bug, not a claim of a task-boundary data race. I would like this report considered for the bounty's correctness/useful-improvements track

results.author: chonilius
results.body_snippet: ## Problem #415 complained the card link had an unwieldy accessible name. The fix sets `aria-label={`${title}, ${reward}`}` on the `<Link>`. `aria-label` overrides the subtree, so screen-reader users now hear only title and reward. Status (open/funded/claimed), difficulty, deadline and "claimed by" (all visible to sighted users) are unavailable, and these are exactly the facts needed to decide whether to open the bounty. ## Suggested fix Use `aria-labelledby` pointing at the title plus `aria-des

results.title: Deadline countdown says 'deadline passed' for a bounty that is due later today
results.author: chonilius
results.body_snippet: ## Problem `daysUntil` compares UTC calendar days, so a deadline later today gives `0`, and `formatDaysUntil` only treats `days > 0` as remaining. Everything else renders `deadline.passed`. A bounty due at 23:00 UTC shows as already expired from 00:00 UTC, which discourages claims on bounties that are still open. Negative and zero are conflated. ## Suggested fix Distinguish `0` ("Due today") from `< 0` (passed), or compute from the exact timestamp (hours remaining when under 1 day). Related: #10

results.author: chonilius
results.body_snippet: ## Problem `MaintainerDashboardPage` renders `fetchBounties(mockBounties)`, the full public board, as the maintainer's "pipeline", along with the stats derived from it. A maintainer of one repository sees every other project's bounties in their Kanban columns and counts. ## Suggested fix Filter by the maintainer's repositories (backend: `repositoryId` filter plus a "my repositories" endpoint), and show an empty state with "Connect repository" when there are none. Related: #88, #226

results.title: No UI to create teams, edit splits, or assign a team to a bounty

The DashboardShell "Team" nav item points at the overview (#219). ## Suggested fix Add a Team page: create a team with members and percentages (reusing `validateTeamSplits`), edit splits, and assign the team to a bounty. Related: #5, #85, #219

The frontend never calls it. The maintainer dashboard shows a "Repositories synced" stat with no way to add one. ## Suggested fix Add a "Connect repository" action on the maintainer dashboard that runs the sync (following `nextPage`) and lists synced repositories. Related: #129

results.title: Every sitemap entry reports lastModified = now, so crawlers can't tell what actually changed
results.author: chonilius
results.body_snippet: ## Problem `buildSitemapEntries` sets `lastModified: now` for static routes, every bounty and every profile. On each rebuild (hourly), the whole site claims to have changed. Google ignores `lastmod` from sites where it's consistently inaccurate. ## Suggested fix Use the bounty's `updatedAt` (and the snapshot's `computedAt` for profiles), and omit `lastModified` for static routes. Related: #248

results.title: Sitemap lists mock bounty URLs when the backend is unreachable, and caches them for an hour
results.author: chonilius
results.body_snippet: ## Problem `buildSitemapEntries` uses `fetchBounties(mockBounties)`, which silently returns the mock fixtures on any error. The resulting `/issues/<mock id>` URLs go into the production sitemap. Those pages 404 once the backend is back, or render sample data. The module-level `cache` then holds the outage snapshot for `SITEMAP_CACHE_TTL_MS` (1 h). ## Suggested fix Exclude `source === "mock"` results from the sitemap (in production), and don't cache a sitemap that was built from fallback data. results.author: chonilius
results.body_snippet: ## Problem `src/app/page.tsx` imports `platformStats` from `lib/mock-data` and renders "total paid out", "bounties completed", "active contributors" and "avg payout time" from it, with no live fetch and no `DataSourceNotice`. The backend exposes a cached `GET /analytics/platform` (`totalBounties`, `totalPaidOut`, `totalRepos`) for exactly this hero. Every visitor sees fixed marketing numbers presented as live platform totals. ## Suggested fix Fetch `/analytics/platform` (`revalidate: 60`), rende

results.title: Bounty status polling never stops for terminal states (paid, refunded, expired)
results.author: chonilius
results.body_snippet: ## Problem `useBountyStatus` keeps `useSmartPolling` enabled regardless of status. Once a bounty is `paid`, `refunded` or `expired`, it can never change again, yet the page keeps polling (backing off to 30 s) for as long as the tab stays open. ## Suggested fix Pass `enabled: !TERMINAL_STATUSES.has(status)` so polling stops once a terminal status is observed. Related: #46, #570

results.title: Each issue page runs two independent pollers on the same bounty (ClaimButton every 2s, LiveBountyStatus every 5s)
results.author: chonilius
results.body_snippet: ## Problem `IssueDetailPage` renders `<LiveBountyStatus interval={5000}>` and, for funded bounties, `<ClaimButton>`, whose own `useBountyStatus({ interval: 2000 })` polls separately. Each poller calls `fetchBounty` (full bounty, `cache: "no-store"`). A single open tab makes about 42 backend requests a minute for one bounty. Multiply by visitors and tabs, and the board's busiest bounties dominate backend load, especially with the backend's flat per-IP throttle. ## Suggested fix Share one poll per

results.title: A backend outage turns a real bounty's page into a 404
results.author: chonilius
results.body_snippet: ## Problem `fetchBounty` swallows every error (timeout, 5xx, network) and returns the mock fallback, which is `undefined` for any real UUID. `IssueDetailPage` then calls `notFound()`. A transient backend blip serves real bounty URLs as **404 Not Found**: search engines may drop them, and users see "doesn't exist" instead of "try again". ## Suggested fix Distinguish "backend said 404" from "backend unavailable". Throw on the latter so the route's `error.tsx` renders a retryable error (and return

results.title: Issue page metadata uses the raw markdown body as the OG/Twitter description, untruncated
results.author: chonilius
results.body_snippet: ## Problem `generateMetadata` sets `description = bounty.description`, the full GitHub issue body with markdown syntax (`##`, `- [ ]`, code fences, image links). Link previews in Slack, X and Discord show raw markup, and search snippets can be thousands of characters. `stripMarkdownToPlainText` already exists in `lib/markdown.ts`. ## Suggested fix Use `stripMarkdownToPlainText(description)` truncated to about 160 characters on a word boundary. Related: #89, #199

results.title: The status filter has no 'funded' option — the only state a contributor can actually claim
results.author: chonilius
results.body_snippet: ## Problem `STATUS_VALUES = ["all", "open", "in_review"]`. Claiming is only possible from `funded` (`IssueActions` renders `ClaimButton` only for `funded`, and the backend allows `FUNDED → CLAIMED`). A contributor looking for claimable work can't filter for it, and the "Open" pill shows *unfunded* bounties that can't be claimed. ## Suggested fix Add `funded` (labelled "Claimable"), and consider making it the default view. results.title: Bounty board says every bounty is 'backed by funds already locked in escrow' while listing unfunded OPEN bounties

Contributors are told an unfunded bounty is guaranteed. ## Suggested fix Make the claim conditional ("Funded bounties are backed by…"), and show an explicit "Not yet funded" badge on OPEN cards. results.author: chonilius

results.title: parse_duration() ignores seconds
results.author: VARUN3WARE
results.body_snippet: `parse_duration("1m30s")` returns `60` instead of `90`. The `s` unit is accepted by the pattern but contributes nothing. `parse_duration("45s")` returns `0`.

results.title: word_count() miscounts extra whitespace
results.author: VARUN3WARE
results.body_snippet: `word_count("hello world")` (two spaces) returns `3`, and `word_count("")` returns `1`. Words separated by any amount of whitespace, including tabs and newlines, should count once: `word_count("one\ttwo\nthree")` should be `3`. Empty or whitespace-only text has 0 words.

results.title: chunk() drops the last partial chunk
